visual.description: Primary white background used for content sections throughout the site.
Warm off-white/cream surface used for alternating content sections and cards.
Deep dark teal used as the dominant background for hero sections, testimonial blocks, and footer-adjacent dark panels.
Near-black dark charcoal used for all primary headings and strong body text.
Dark gray used for body copy and paragraph text throughout light sections.
White navigation bar background in both top and scrolled states.
Dark charcoal text color for navigation links in both states.
Vivid burnt orange used for all primary CTA buttons, logo background circle, and interactive highlights.
Burnt orange accent color used for highlighted text spans, underlines, and decorative emphasis throughout the site.
Muted golden yellow used for highlighted accent words in headings on dark teal backgrounds.
Navigation link text color (same as page background in transparent state; nav is white-background so links appear dark).
Pure black used for the top announcement/promo banner strip.
White text used inside the black announcement banner.
Very dark near-black charcoal used for the bottom-most footer/CTA strip.
Very light warm gray used for subtle dividers and accordion separator lines.
Burnt orange used for inline text links and portfolio 'see more' hyperlinks.
Slightly lighter teal used for Google review card backgrounds within the dark testimonial section.
